cards.design_implication: If designing a study to investigate this specific material class, the scope may include examining the intersection of ferroic properties and electronic functions to explore potential for new research avenues in structural and magnetic correlations.
does_not_establish: Specific experimental results for a particular compound
cards.evidence_excerpt: Here, a broad family of layered metal thio(seleno)phosphate materials that are moderate- to wide-bandgap semiconductors with incipient ionic conductivity and a host of ferroic properties are reviewed. It is argued that this material class has the potential to merge the sought-after properties of complex oxides with electronic functions of 2D and quasi-2D electronic materials, as well as to create new avenues for both applied and fundamental materials research in structural and magnetic correlations.
limitations: This claim is based on an abstract-level review argument and does not represent original experimental validation of a specific mechanism in this paper.
cards.statement: The reviewed class of layered metal thio(seleno)phosphate materials is argued to have the potential to merge properties of complex oxides with electronic functions of 2D materials and create avenues for research in structural and magnetic correlations.
